output.subject: We've received your complaint about your 401k check deposit
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for contacting us, and for being a customer with us for many years. We have received your complaint, and we want to confirm what you told us.

You mentioned that you deposited a $2,280 check from your old 401k on September 11, and that the funds are shown as available on September 18. You told us the check comes from a real company and you are confident it will not bounce, and that the hold has left you feeling treated like a check kiter rather than a long-standing customer. You also mentioned that you sent a secure message through the app on September 9 and have not received a reply.

You have asked us to explain why the check is being held and to release the funds. We're sorry for the frustration this has caused, and we understand how difficult it is to wait for money you were expecting.

A specialist team is reviewing your complaint and will respond to you within 10 business days.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: The customer says the secure message was sent September 9, two days before the September 11 deposit. Confirm the date and what that message was about.
Check whether the September 9 secure message was received and whether it was answered.
Confirm the hold details: amount, deposit date, and the September 18 availability date.
Decide whether to address the requested explanation and early release of funds. The draft only acknowledges these requests.
The customer mentions being a long-standing customer. Verify their account history if it is relevant to your response.
The customer selected the topic 'Other'. Confirm it is categorized correctly.
